Name: Animal Cracker Expanded
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b]Animal Cracker Expanded[/b][/size]

Animal Cracker Expanded lets farm animals and fish ponds accept multiple Golden Animal Crackers, with each cracker increasing their cracker-boosted production. It also adds optional pig/truffle support, an Animal Cracker Wand for recovering crackers you've already used, visible cracker counts, optional Animal Husbandry Mod meat support, and more.

[b]Works on both Desktop and Android.[/b]

The mod automatically detects whether Stardew Valley is running on Desktop or Android and loads the appropriate platform-specific compatibility code. 


[size=4][b]HOW MULTIPLE CRACKERS WORK[/b][/size]

The first Golden Animal Cracker still behaves like Stardew Valley's normal cracker.

Animal Cracker Expanded then allows you to feed additional crackers up to your configured maximum.

Each effective cracker adds another copy of the normal production amount:

0 crackers = normal production
1 cracker = 2x production
2 crackers = 3x production
3 crackers = 4x production
4 crackers = 5x production
5 crackers = 6x production

The default maximum is 5 total crackers per animal or fish pond.

The maximum can be changed in the config or through Generic Mod Config Menu.

Animals which use Stardew Valley's normal Golden Animal Cracker and production systems should retain their normal behavior while gaining the additional cracker scaling provided by this mod.


[size=4][b]FARM ANIMALS[/b][/size]

Animals which normally accept Golden Animal Crackers can be given additional crackers after receiving their first one.

The additional crackers are saved directly on the animal, so their count persists with the animal.

Production handled through Stardew's standard animal production paths is expanded accordingly, including normal collected or automatically produced animal goods.


[size=4][b]PIGS AND DIG-UP ANIMALS[/b][/size]

Pig / truffle support is included and enabled by default.

This allows pigs and other compatible DigUp farm animals to accept Golden Animal Crackers even though vanilla Stardew normally doesn't use crackers for their dug-up produce.

Their successful dug-up produce is multiplied according to the same cracker system.

This feature can be disabled in the config if you prefer vanilla behavior.


[size=4][b]FISH PONDS[/b][/size]

Fish ponds can also accept multiple Golden Animal Crackers.

Additional crackers increase Golden Animal Cracker pond production using the same scaling system as animals.

The pond menu displays the current cracker count and configured maximum.

Fish pond cracker counts are shown in the fish pond menu.

Horizontal and vertical positioning can be adjusted separately for the Animals tab and fish pond menu through the config/GMCM if needed for your screen or UI setup.


[size=4][b]ANIMAL CRACKER WAND[/b][/size]

Animal Cracker Expanded includes an Animal Cracker Wand which can recover Golden Animal Crackers that have already been fed to an animal or fish pond.

After Golden Animal Cracker use is detected, the wand unlock is queued and Marnie sends you a letter the following day.

By default, the wand can be obtained either:

• from Marnie's shop
• by crafting it

You can change this to Shop only, Crafting only, or Both.

Default shop price:
25,000g

Default crafting recipe:
10 Hardwood
5 Iridium Bars
1 Diamond

The wand can recover crackers either:

• one at a time
• all at once

One at a time is the default.

If your inventory is full when crackers are recovered, any crackers which don't fit are dropped safely near the player.


[size=4][b]ANIMAL HUSBANDRY MOD SUPPORT[/b][/size]

Optional compatibility with Animal Husbandry Mod by Digus is included.

When Animal Husbandry meat support is enabled, Golden Animal Crackers also increase the amount of meat received when butchering an animal.

The same multiplier model is used:

1 cracker = 2x meat
2 crackers = 3x meat
5 crackers = 6x meat

Only the actual meat output is multiplied.

Other Animal Husbandry results such as wool, feathers, rabbit feet, contest ribbons, or other non-meat extras are not intentionally duplicated.

[b]Animal Husbandry meat support is OFF by default[/b] and it[/font][font=Comic Sans MS] is completely optional.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]

[size=4][b]CAPYBARA SUPPORT[/b][/size]

Optional support is included for HarrisonGrey's Capybara.

That mod intentionally disables normal Golden Animal Cracker feeding, so Animal Cracker Expanded respects that behavior by default.

If you want Capybaras to participate in the expanded cracker system, enable:

[b]Capybara cracker support[/b]


[size=4][b]CONFIGURATION[/b][/size]

Generic Mod Config Menu is optional but recommended.

Available settings include:

• Wand acquisition: Shop / Crafting / Both
• Wand shop price
• Maximum total crackers
• Pig / truffle support
• Capybara cracker support
• Animal Husbandry meat support
• Wand refund mode: One at a time / All at once
• Animals tab cracker-count horizontal offset
• Animals tab cracker-count vertical offset
• Fish pond cracker-count horizontal offset
• Fish pond cracker-count vertical offset

[b]Tested on:[/b]

Desktop:
Stardew Valley 1.6.15
SMAPI 4.5.2

Android:
Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3
SMAPI Android 4.3.2.5


[size=4][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size]

[b]Required:[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6
• SMAPI

[b]Optional:[/b]
• Generic Mod Config Menu — for easy in-game configuration
• Animal Husbandry Mod — only required for the optional meat multiplier
• HarrisonGrey's Capybara — only relevant to the optional Capybara compatibility setting


[size=4][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size]

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download Animal Cracker Expanded.
3. Extract the folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
4. Start the game through SMAPI.

The installed folder should contain:

Animal Cracker Expanded/
    AnimalCrackerExpanded.dll
    manifest.json
    assets/
    i18n/


[size=4][b]BUG REPORTS[/b][/size]

If you find a reproducible problem, please use the [b]Bugs[/b] section of this Nexus page.

Include:

• what you were doing when the problem happened
• whether you're playing on Desktop or Android
• the animal or fish pond involved, if relevant
• your relevant Animal Cracker Expanded settings
• a fresh SMAPI-latest.txt generated immediately after reproducing the problem

A SMAPI log is especially important for compatibility problems.
